speech.text:
Where on Earth can we study places
like the Moon and Mars?

Pick a target,
like Jezero Crater on Mars,

and explore documented Earth analogs
such as the Atacama Desert.

NASA POWER adds regional climate data
for each Earth site,

and side-by-side comparisons
show which features match —
and where the analogy breaks down.

A starting point
for students and explorers.
